name: awesome-ai-video-prompts
description: Awesome AI video prompts: curated text-to-video and image-to-video prompts for Kling 3.0, Veo 3, Wan 2.5, Runway Gen-4 and Seedance, each with model, mode, duration, a why-it-works note and a render-report field. Camera moves, lighting and motion vocab. Plus Sora alternatives after the shutdown. CC BY 4.0. By UniqAI.
notes: Description and topics from the shared meta.json, with two changes: the license word is CC BY 4.0 (the org convention for data repos, and what LICENSE says), not CC0; and 'what the clip looked like' became 'a render-report field', because most entries in 0.1.0 have no render report yet (see README, Limits and honesty). Model names match references/model-notes.md (Runway Gen-4 family, Seedance 2.x). When uniqai.app/prompts is published, switch homepage to it.
